apiVersion: batch/v1beta1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: audit-log
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: media-streaming
    team: infra
    env: production
  annotations:
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/schedule-history-limit: "3"
spec:
  schedule: "0 1 * * *" # Every day at 1 AM UTC
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: media-streaming
            team: infra
            env: production
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: audit-log
            image: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/aspnet:3.1-buster-slim
            ports:
            - containerPort: 80
            env:
            - name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
              value: "Production"
            - name: DOTNET_RUNNING_IN_CONTAINER
              value: "true"
            - name: Logging__LogLevel__Default
              value: "Information"
            - name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
              value: "http://+:80"
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token"
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-secret
                  key: password
          restartPolicy: OnFailure

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: recommendation-checkout-deployment
  namespace: recommendation-checkout-qa
  labels:
    app: recommendation-checkout
    team: energy
    env: qa
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: recommendation-checkout
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: recommendation-checkout
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: recommendation-checkout-container
          image: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:7.0 AS base
            WORKDIR /app
            EXPOSE 80
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
              value: Development
            - name: DOTNET_RUNNING_IN_CONTAINER
              value: "true"
            - name: Logging__LogLevel__Default
              value: Information
            - name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
              value: http://+:80
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: X-Api-Token
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: 3600
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: recommendation-checkout-secret
                  key: db_password
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
              protocol: TCP

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: notification
  namespace: core-qa
  labels:
    app: media-streaming
    team: content-platform
    env: qa
  annotations:
    description: "Deployment for the notification service in QA environment"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: media-streaming
      team: content-platform
      env: qa
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: media-streaming
        team: content-platform
        env: qa
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: notification
          image: registry.example.com/media-streaming/notification:v1.0.2@sha256:c8a27b9f1b4c3d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0g1h2i3j4k5l6m7n8o9p0q1r2s3t4u5v6w7x8y9z0
          env:
            - name: GOMAXPROCS
              value: "4"
            - name: LOG_LEVEL
              value: "debug"
            - name: HTTP_TIMEOUT
              value: "60s"
            - name: GO_ENV
              value: "production"
            - name: METRICS_PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token" # placeholder for an actual header name, not a secret
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-secret
                  key: password
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080

apiVersion: batch/v1beta1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: web-telemetry-cronjob
  namespace: web-staging
  labels:
    app: web-telemetry
    team: logistics
    env: staging
spec:
  schedule: "0 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: web-telemetry
            team: logistics
            env: staging
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: web-telemetry
            image: gcr.io/logistics-web-staging/web-telemetry:v1.2.3@sha256:1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0jklmnopqrstuvwx
            env:
            - name: GOMAXPROCS
              value: "4"
            - name: LOG_LEVEL
              value: "info"
            - name: HTTP_TIMEOUT
              value: "30s"
            - name: GO_ENV
              value: "production"
            - name: METRICS_PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token"
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"

      app: gateway-auth-qa

      containers:

              value: "X-Api-Token"

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: ledger-dev
  namespace: ledger-dev
  labels:
    app: ledger
    team: finance
    env: dev
annotations:
  description: DaemonSet for managing ledger application in development environment
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ledger
      team: finance
      env: dev
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ledger
        team: finance
        env: dev
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ledger-dev
        image: public.ecr.aws/lambda/java:11-v3.0
        env:
        - name: JAVA_OPTS
          value: "-Xmx512m"
        - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
          value: dev
        - name: DB_POOL_SIZE
          value: "10"
        - name: JVM_HEAP_MAX
          value: "512m"
        - name: MANAGEMENT_SERVER_PORT
          value: "8080"
        - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
          value: X-Api-Token
        - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
          value: "3600"
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: ledger-dev-secrets
              key: db-password
      volumes:
      - name: config-volume
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: data-volume
        hostPath:
          path: /data/ledger-dev
          type: DirectoryOrCreate
      tolerations:
      - key: "dedicated"
        operator: "Equal"
        value: "database"
        effect: "NoSchedule"
      affinity:
        nodeAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            nodeSelectorTerms:
            - matchExpressions:
              - key: kubernetes.io/e2e-az-name
                operator: In
                values:
                - e2e-az1
                - e2e-az2
      imagePullSecrets:
      - name: regcred

apiVersion: batch/v1

  jobTemplate:

            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER

              value: "4"

            - name: WORKERS_PER_CORE

  name: billing-invoice
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: billing-service
    team: finance
    env: production
  annotations:
    scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/critical-pod: ""
spec:
  schedule: "0 * * * *" # Run every hour
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: billing-service
            team: finance
            env: production
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: billing-invoice
            image: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/sdk:3.1 AS builder
            args:
            - dotnet
            - publish
            - -c
            - Release
            - -o
            - /app/publish
            volumeMounts:
            - name: app-config
              mountPath: /app/config
          - name: billing-invoice-runtime
            image: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/aspnet:3.1
            args:
            - dotnet
            - /app/publish/billing-invoice.dll
            env:
            - name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
              value: Production
            - name: DOTNET_RUNNING_IN_CONTAINER
              value: "true"
            - name: Logging__LogLevel__Default
              value: Information
            - name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
              value: http://+:8080
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: X-Api-Token
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-secret
                  key: password
            volumeMounts:
            - name: app-config
              mountPath: /app/config
          volumes:
          - name: app-config
            configMap:
              name: billing-invoice-config
      restartPolicy: OnFailure

  name: core-notification-search-build-$(date +%s)
  namespace: core-dev
  labels:
    app: core-notification-search
    team: energy
    env: dev
  annotations:
    scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/critical-pod: ""
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: core-notification-search
        team: energy
        env: dev
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: core-notification-search-build
        image: docker.io/library/openjdk:17-jdk-slim@sha256:f4d8a3e9b0f4c1e2d3f4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6
        env:
        - name: JAVA_OPTS
          value: "-Xmx4g"
        - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
          value: "dev"
        - name: DB_POOL_SIZE
          value: "20"
        - name: JVM_HEAP_MAX
          value: "3g"
        - name: MANAGEMENT_SERVER_PORT
          value: "8081"
        - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
          value: "X-Api-Token"  # Non-secret placeholder for HTTP header name
        - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
          value: "3600"  # Numeric placeholder value
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: core-dev-db-creds
              key: password
        - name: REDIS_HOST
          value: "redis.example.com"
        - name: REDIS_PORT
          value: "6379"
      restartPolicy: Never

  namespace: shipment-checkout-prod
  labels:
    app: mobile-shipment-checkout
    team: logistics
    env: prod
  annotations:
    description: "Realiza verificação de embarques móveis em produção."
spec:
  schedule: "0 1 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: mobile-shipment-checkout
            team: logistics
            env: prod
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: mobile-shipment-checkout
            image: "mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:6.0-alpine@sha256:e340a8b1e7f9f0c7d1b5c1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8g9h0i1j2k3l4m5n6o7p8q9r0s1t2u3v4w5x6y7z8"
            env:
            - name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
              value: "Production"
            - name: DOTNET_RUNNING_IN_CONTAINER
              value: "true"
            - name: Logging__LogLevel__Default
              value: "Information"
            - name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
              value: "http://+:80"
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token"
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: shipment-checkout-prod-secrets
                  key: db-password
          restartPolicy: OnFailure

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: audit-log
  namespace: audit-log-staging
  labels:
    app: audit-log
    team: streaming-platform
    env: staging
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/description: "Deployment for the audit log service in staging environment"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: audit-log
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: audit-log
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: audit-log-container
        image: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:6.0 AS base
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        env:
        - name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
          value: "Staging"
        - name: DOTNET_RUNNING_IN_CONTAINER
          value: "true"
        - name: Logging__LogLevel__Default
          value: "Information"
        - name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
          value: "http://+:80"
        - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
          value: "X-Api-Token"  # Fake header name, not a secret
        - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
          value: "3600"  # Fake timeout value, not a secret
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: audit-log-secrets
              key: db-password
      imagePullSecrets:
      - name: mcr-secret

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-catalog-telemetry-deployment
  namespace: media-streaming-qa
  labels:
    app: web-catalog-telemetry
    team: streaming-team
    env: qa
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-catalog-telemetry
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-catalog-telemetry
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web-catalog-telemetry
          image: nginx@sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
          env:
            - name: NODE_ENV
              value: "production"
            - name: PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: NPM_CONFIG_LOGLEVEL
              value: "error"
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: LOG_FORMAT
              value: "%h %l %u %t \"%r\" %>s %b \"%{Referer}i\" \"%{User-Agent}i\""
            - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
              value: "X-Api-Token"
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: media-streaming-db-secret
                  key: password
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: enrollment-deployment
  namespace: enrollment-staging
  labels:
    app: enrollment
    team: frontend
    env: staging
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: enrollment
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: enrollment
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: enrollment-container
        image: gcr.io/google-samples/hello-app:1.0
        env:
        - name: GOMAXPROCS
          value: "2"
        - name: LOG_LEVEL
          value: "info"
        - name: HTTP_TIMEOUT
          value: "30s"
        - name: GO_ENV
          value: "staging"
        - name: METRICS_PORT
          value: "8080"
        - name: API_TOKEN_HEADER
          value: "X-Api-Token"
        - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
          value: "3600"
        - name: DATABASE_URL
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: enrollment-secret
              key: db-url
      volumes:
      - name: config-volume
        configMap:
          name: enrollment-config
      - name: tls-certs-volume
        secret:
          secretName: enrollment-tls-certs
      - name: data-volume
        emptyDir: {}
      containers:
      - name: enrollment-container
        volumeMounts:
        - name: config-volume
          mountPath: /etc/config
        - name: tls-certs-volume
          mountPath: /etc/tls
        - name: data-volume
          mountPath: /data
      serviceAccountName: enrollment-service-account
